text:
mike_rep: Hey team — ZenHealth procurement emailed: they need a minimal compliance bundle for the POC by Monday AM. Request: SOC 2 scope page, ISO27001 crypto excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (POC-limited), and confirmation we can provide ephemeral staging creds via mTLS certs. Who can own what?
tasha_sales: Ill coordinate. We can produce SOC2 scope + ISO excerpt. Pen-test attestation: we have a template but legal needs to sign. @frank_legal can you review?
frank_legal: will review the attestation. Reminder — we only sign attestations for customers with executed NDA + DPA. Is that in place?
mike_rep: NDA + DPA are done (zen-nda-2026). Contact for signature is security@zenhealth.io.
evahn_se: We support ephemeral mTLS certs for staging with 2-hr TTL and key usage restricted to inference and staging S3. Need tenant-id and list of CNs to issue certs. We also require their IP CIDRs for peering.
noelle_security: For the KMS separation diagram: platform keys live at kms://redwood/platform/*, customer keys at kms://redwood/customers/<tenant-id>/*. We can provide a single-page diagram and a one-paragraph backup-encryption note.
tasha_sales: Pricing note: they asked whether dedicated tenancy for POC changes cost. Ballpark: isolated single node week = ~$3k; reserved short-term commit required for dedicated GPUs. I'll confirm final with finance.
frank_legal: Legal review started. For the attestation, include explicit scope: "POC only, data residency eu-west-1, no report distribution". I'll sign if OK. ETA 6 hours.
aud_it: automated: Please attach tenant-id to this thread to scope S3 uploads and permission grants.
mike_rep: tenant-id = zen-prod-poc1.
evahn_se: I'll draft the mTLS issuance runbook and upload to internal runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-mtls. For POC we can do scripted issuance if they supply CNs and a contact.
noelle_security: Uploading SOC2 scope extract and ISO A.10 excerpt to s3://redwood-compliance/zenhealth/poc-bundle/. Pen-test attestation draft placed in /legal/drafts/zenhealth-pen-attest.docx and marked pending.
tasha_sales: Can someone confirm we can provide a one-page redacted findings summary instead of raw report? Customer auditors asked for evidence of remediation, not full report.
noelle_security: We provide a redacted findings summary with timelines and remediation status. No exploit PoCs or raw logs will be shared.
frank_legal: Acknowledged. Once I get the attestation scope (mike, confirm data residency and exact signatory name) I'll sign.
mike_rep: Confirming eu-west-1 residency and signer = Julie Park, CISO (julie.park@zenhealth.io).
evahn_se: Setup ETA: for hosted-eu isolated tenancy + mTLS cred issuance ~48 hours after CIDRs and CN list. I'll also note network peering steps in the SOW.
noelle_security: Links: s3://redwood-compliance/zenhealth/poc-bundle/soc2-scope.pdf, s3://redwood-compliance/zenhealth/poc-bundle/iso-a10-excerpt.pdf, /legal/drafts/zenhealth-pen-attest.docx (pending).
tasha_sales: I'll assemble the email bundle to security@zenhealth.io and copy Julie. Will include pricing ballpark, SOW one-liner, and setup ETA. Will attach redacted findings summary once legal signs.
mike_rep: Thanks all — deadline Monday AM, appreciate the quick turnaround.
evahn_se: If auditors want control-to-test mapping, tag me and I can produce a small table.
noelle_security: Will follow up in thread once attestation is signed.
frank_legal: Will post signature confirmation here when done.
tasha_sales: Closing thread after send. :white_check_mark:
